def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    x = list(map(int, data[2:]))
    
    if m == 1:
        print(0)
        return
    
    distances = []
    for i in range(m - 1):
        distances.append(abs(x[i + 1] - x[i]))
    
    total_length = sum(distances)
    max_saving = 0
    
    for i in range(m - 1):
        max_saving = max(max_saving, distances[i])
    
    print(total_length - max_saving)
